part.text:
Fixed. The panic occurred in `tree.go` where `getValue` expanded the params slice (`(*value.params)[:i+1]`) without checking capacity — when `HandleContext`/`CreateTestContext` provides a zero-capacity params slice, this panics with "slice bounds out of range".

The fix (tree.go:632 and tree.go:678) guards the param-saving logic with `cap(*params) > 0`, matching upstream gin PR #2755:

```go
if params != nil && cap(*params) > 0 {
```

Verified:
- The issue's reproduction program no longer panics and completes successfully
- The full test suite passes (`go test ./...`), including `TestTreeInvalidParamsType`
- Only `tree.go` was modified; no test files touched
